scripts.serve: cd src && cp --parents -R components/**/*.html static/ && cd .. && cp node_modules/ol/ol.css src/static/components/ol/ && vite serve
scripts.build: cd src && cp --parents -R components/**/*.html static/ && cd .. && cp node_modules/ol/ol.css src/static/components/ol/ && vite build
scripts.serve_win: cd src && xcopy components\*.html static\components\ /S /Y && cd .. && xcopy node_modules\ol\ol.css src\static\components\ol\ /Y && vite serve
scripts.build_win: cd src && xcopy components\*.html static\components\ /S /Y && cd .. && xcopy node_modules\ol\ol.css src\static\ol\ /Y && vite build
